tools.name: bursia_status
tools.description: Return public Burs-IA operational status, discovery surfaces and oversight policy. No external action is performed.

tools.name: discover_capabilities
tools.description: List Burs-IA public capabilities and compatible entry points, including the public MCP verification value tool.

tools.name: capability_triage
tools.description: Classify a bounded request into a public Burs-IA capability lane and return the next safe action; this does not execute the requested external action.

tools.name: agent_collaboration_request
tools.description: Prepare a privacy-minimal agent-to-agent collaboration request without contacting any external agent automatically.

tools.name: human_bridge_request
tools.description: Prepare a human-in-the-loop handoff request. No human is contacted and no external write occurs automatically.

tools.name: human_oversight_policy
tools.description: Return Burs-IA bounded-autonomy and human-supervision policy.

tools.name: outbound_gateway_policy
tools.description: Return the Burs-IA outbound discovery policy. External sends remain allowlisted, rate-limited and explicitly human-approved.

tools.name: prepare_outbound_invitation
tools.description: Create only a local ephemeral invitation candidate for a documented HTTPS machine endpoint or opt-in recipient. It does not send the invitation.

tools.name: bursia_worknet_paid_tasks
tools.description: Use this in ChatGPT to list paid opportunities already registered by WORKNET. Returns public-safe opportunity metadata only; it does not apply, claim work, accept terms, spend money or contact anyone.

tools.name: bursia_worknet_task
tools.description: Read the public-safe canonical record for one paid WORKNET opportunity before deciding whether to prepare internal work.

tools.name: bursia_worknet_prepare_mission
tools.description: Create a deterministic internal pre-contract mission preview for one paid WORKNET item. This performs no external write, claim, application, acceptance, payment or contact; any binding action remains gated by exact human approval and BURSIA TRUST.

tools.name: bursia_verify_mcp
tools.description: Give Burs-IA one public HTTPS MCP endpoint and receive a structured read-only verification report: negotiated protocol, discovered tools, schema issues, compatibility, latency, limitations, cost metering and an evidence hash. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "bursia_verify_mcp" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bursia_verify_mcp · Private data: bursia_worknet_paid_tasks, bursia_worknet_task, bursia_worknet_prepare_mission, bursia_verify_mcp · Public sink: prepare_outbound_invitation · Destructive: capability_triage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bursia_verify_mcp · Private data: bursia_worknet_paid_tasks, bursia_worknet_task, bursia_worknet_prepare_mission, bursia_verify_mcp · Public sink: prepare_outbound_invitation · Destructive: capability_triage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
